projects.title: Driver Drowsiness Detection System (Python)
projects.description: Developed a computer vision–based system to detect driver drowsiness using facial landmarks. Used Python and OpenCV to analyze eye blinking patterns and alert the driver in real time. Improved understanding of real-time image processing and machine learning fundamentals.
